sample_unit: questions and scenarios (18 theoretical, 18 clinical scenarios, 18 patient questions)

links.outcome: Transparency of source citation in LLM responses to pediatric ORL questions
links.effect: AI responses lacked transparency in citing reliable sources; no numeric result reported in the abstract.
links.quote: However, AI responses lacked transparency in citing reliable sources and were less effective in addressing patient-centered questions.

screen.reason: The study empirically compares multiple commercial LLMs against human clinicians across theoretical, clinical, and patient-facing questions in pediatric otorhinolaryngology, but evaluates model performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
